teaser.en: Its leaves can reach eight metres, among the longest in the plant world, and its young leaflets give the raffia used for mats and string.
teaser.sw: Majani yake yanaweza kufikia mita nane, miongoni mwa majani marefu zaidi katika ulimwengu wa mimea, na vijani vyake vichanga hutoa nyuzi za raffia zinazotumika kwa mikeka na kamba.
teaser.dg: Makodzage ganaweza kufika mita nane, ni kahi ya makodza mare zaidi ga mimea yosi duniani, na makodza madide matsanga ganalavya mlala unaohumirwa kuhenda majamvi na nyugbwe.

summary.en: The raffia palm, also called *mtsikitsi* by the Digo, is a massive clustering palm of freshwater swamp forest and river banks on the south coast. It gives raffia fibre, rafters, chairs and thatch, but it is disappearing as its swamps are cleared.
summary.sw: Mwaale, unaoitwa pia *mtsikitsi* na Wadigo, ni mmea mkubwa sana wa jamii ya mnazi unaokua kwa vichaka katika misitu ya vinamasi vya maji baridi na kingo za mito pwani ya kusini. Hutoa nyuzi za raffia, mataruma ya paa, viti na makuti ya kuezekea, lakini unatoweka kadiri vinamasi vyake vinavyofyekwa.
summary.dg: Muhi hinyu wa mlala, ambao Adigo anauiha piya *mtsikitsi*, ni muhi mkulu sana wa jamii ya minazi unaomera kpwa mafungu kpwenye matsaka ga madimbwi ga madzi gasigo na munyu na kanda-kanda ya miho pwani ya kusini. Unalavya mlala, maphalu, vihi na makodza ga kuezekera, ela unaangamika kpwa sababu madimbwige ganatsuswa.

about.en:
This is a giant among palms. It grows in clumps, its trunks covered in the old bases of fallen leaves. The leaves stand erect and can reach 8 metres long, with crimson-brown stalks.

The fruits are covered in shiny, overlapping scales like the skin of a reptile or a pine cone, and hang in long, heavy clusters.
about.sw:
Huu ni jitu miongoni mwa mimea ya jamii ya mnazi. Hukua kwa vichaka, na mashina yake yamefunikwa na vitako vya zamani vya majani yaliyoanguka. Majani yake husimama wima na yanaweza kufikia urefu wa mita 8, yakiwa na mikono ya rangi ya kahawia-nyekundu iliyokolea.

Matunda yake yamefunikwa na magamba yanayong'aa yanayopishana kama ngozi ya mtambaazi au koni ya msonobari, na huning'inia kwa vishada virefu vizito.
about.dg:
Hinyu ni muhi mkulu sana kahi ya mihi ya jamii ya minazi. Unamera kpwa mafungu, na makologe ganafwinikpwa ni masina ga makodza ga kare garigogbwa. Makodza ganaima chocho na ganaweza kufika mita 8 kpwa ure, na militaye ni ya rangi ya kundu na dongo.

Matunda ganafwinikpwa ni mamba ganagong'arira ganagopandana, dza ngozi ya nyoka au tunda ra *pine*, na ganagbwadzika kpwa mafungu mare na maziho.

where.en: It grows in freshwater swamp forest and on river banks in the swampy valleys of the south coast. These wet places are becoming scarce, so the palm is now harder to find than it once was.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya vinamasi vya maji baridi na kwenye kingo za mito katika mabonde yenye vinamasi ya pwani ya kusini. Maeneo haya yenye majimaji yanazidi kuwa adimu, hivyo mmea huu sasa ni vigumu zaidi kuupata kuliko zamani.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga madimbwi ga madzi gasigo na munyu na kanda-kanda ya miho kpwenye mabonde ga madimbwi ga pwani ya kusini. Phatu phenye madzi higa phanaphunguka, kpwa hivyo sambi ni vigumu kuuphaha kuriko kare.

uses.en: The young leaflets are stripped to give raffia fibre, which is made into ropes, string, mats and baskets. The strong, light midribs of the leaves serve as rafters and are made into chairs and ladders. The leaves are used for thatch, and oil is taken from the fruit.
uses.sw: Vijani vichanga hubanduliwa kupata nyuzi za raffia, ambazo hutengenezwa kuwa kamba, uzi, mikeka na vikapu. Mbavu za katikati za majani, zilizo imara na nyepesi, hutumika kama mataruma ya paa na hutengenezwa kuwa viti na ngazi. Majani hutumika kuezekea, na mafuta hukamuliwa kutoka kwenye matunda.
uses.dg: Makodza madide matsanga nkuyulwa kulavya mlala, unaohendwa kamba, nyugbwe, majamvi na vitsango. Mabati ga makodza, ambago ni magumu na maphepheya, nkuhumirwa dza maphalu na nkuhendwa vihi na ngazi. Makodza nkuhumirwa kuezekera, na mafuha nkulavywa kula matunda.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mtsikitsi* for both the raffia palm and the wild oil palm, so the name needs care. The Mgombato dictionary gives *mtsikitsi* only for the oil palm and cycads. In Swahili, and in Taveta, it is *mwaale*. In English it is the raffia palm, and its scientific name is *Raphia farinifera*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mtsikitsi* kwa mwaale na pia kwa mchikichi wa porini, hivyo jina hili linahitaji uangalifu. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *mtsikitsi* kwa mchikichi na mimea ya jamii ya *cycad* pekee. Kwa Kiswahili, na kwa Kitaveta, ni *mwaale*. Kwa Kiingereza ni *raffia palm*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Raphia farinifera*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mtsikitsi* kpwa muhi hinyu wa mlala na kpwa mnazi wa weruni wa mafuha, kpwa hivyo dzina hiri ni lazima rihumirwe kpwa uangalifu. Kamusi ya Mgombato inalavya *mtsikitsi* kpwa mnazi wa mafuha na *cycads* tu. Kpwa Chiswahili, na kpwa Chitaveta, ni *mwaale*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *raffia palm*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Raphia farinifera*.

conservation.en: It is disappearing as its swamp habitat is destroyed.
conservation.sw: Unatoweka kadiri makazi yake ya vinamasi yanavyoharibiwa.
conservation.dg: Unaangamika kpwa sababu madimbwi ambamo unamera ganabanangwa.

reason.en: The wild oil palm, which shares its Digo name
reason.sw: Mchikichi wa porini, unaoshiriki jina lake la Kidigo
reason.dg: Mnazi wa weruni wa mafuha, ambao una dzina ra Chidigo sawa na hinyu

reason.en: Mgombato's 'raffia' (mlala) is the doum palm's weaving leaf
reason.sw: 'Raffia' ya Mgombato (mlala) ni jani la mkoma linalosukwa
reason.dg: 'Raffia' ya Mgombato (*mlala*) ni kodza ra *mkoma* ra kusuka

reason.en: Another palm of wet places used for weaving
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wa jamii ya mnazi wa maeneo yenye majimaji unaotumika kusuka
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa jamii ya minazi wa phatu pha madzi-madzi, unaohumirwa kusuka

reason.en: Another palm giving fibre, thatch and mats
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wa jamii ya mnazi unaotoa nyuzi, makuti na mikeka
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa jamii ya minazi unaolavya nyuzi, makodza ga kuezekera na majamvi
